# Old News

> A browser extension that remembers every paragraph you read, on your own computer, and fades the ones you have already read. It runs on-device with zero network requests. This site is its landing page and a phone-friendly web app.

## Pages

- [Landing page](/): what it does, how it works, privacy, install
- [Web app](/app/): paste or drop two or more articles and see the same three-tier matcher the extension runs
